issue_context.title: validation has a GCE-ism baked in
comments:
Although I'm not familiar with codes in `pkg/apis`, I'm willing to help with this one as it's labeld `good first issue`.
However, I'm not sure what do you mean by `just get rid of this`, do you mean we don't have to check `readonly` for gce pds from now on?

This should not be marked 
/good-first-issue

without the criteria the bot will comment about when doing so, namely an agreed upon approach rather than a "probably" 😅

Example: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/114369#issuecomment-1342986850

It can be marked help-wanted.

I don't think this validation is critical. If we remove the validation and someone tries to do this, they will get a failure later on (ie attach error), although we may turn the behavior from deterministic to non-deterministic. Without the validation, the first replica will succeed and and the subsequent replicas will get an error. But if that first pod gets deleted, then one of the subsequent pods will win.

But we also don't have this kind of validation for PV types, csi or otherwise. So I think it is ok to remove it and rely on the platform error.

> But we also don't have this kind of validation for PV types, csi or otherwise. So I think it is ok to remove it and rely on the platform error.

In that case, I think I can help with this one by removing this function. Seems like a easy one to me?
/assign
unassign myself for this is not easy as I thought, and I'm not familar with api changes :(
There are some impl notes and hints in the linked PR #114480
OK, I need some time. It is currently being completed
Probably more in sig storage's realm, but we will continue tracking this.
